s01.title: Title & Vision
s01.notes: Anchor the positioning immediately: petsFollow is care continuity guided by the care team. Web practice hub, mobile field caregiver app, client app.

s01.headline: petsFollow
s01.lead: Keep the medical thread between consultations with 3 unified software surfaces.

s02.title: The Clinical Reality
s02.notes: Emphasise front-desk overload for the ASV and loss of information thread for the vet between visits.
s02.headline: The thread lost between consultations
s02.card1Desc: No structured visibility into the daily life of geriatric or monitored patients once the consultation ends.
s02.card2Desc: Unplanned calls, personal texts and scattered emails that disrupt reception without being filed in the record.
s02.card3Desc: Use of consumer apps disconnected from the practice and not guided by the care team.
s02.solution: petsFollow solution: A single professional platform to frame exchanges and reassure the client.

s06.title: VetPro — Key Features
s06.notes: Review the 4 pillars of the Web Practice: Messaging, Timeline, Visit reports and Team management.
s06.headline: Steer activity and follow-up day to day
s06.f1Desc: Structured exchanges per pet, visual/media sharing and automatic respect of closing hours.
s06.f2Desc: Single chronological feed: messages, care events and heart rate readings received if prescribed.
s06.f3Desc: Quick editing and structuring of visit reports (SOAP format / specialties) filed in the record.
s06.f4Desc: Record sharing between colleagues, coordinated clinic agenda and clear commission tracking.
s06.quality: Quality standard: Easy for the entire care team to adopt.

s07.title: VetLight — Mobile Field App
s07.notes: Emphasise VetLight is completely free for mobile visits (home, stables).
s07.headline: The 100% free mobile app for the mobile caregiver
s07.heroTitle: For rounds & visits on the go
s07.heroDesc: Stables, home visits, mobile emergencies and associated caregivers.
s07.point1: Mobile vets: Same account as the practice, immediate access to records and agenda.
s07.point2: Care partners: Farrier, physio, behaviourist, breeder.
s07.point3: Automatic voice dictation: Drastically reduces evening report writing time.
s07.footer: Web Practice + Mobile Field App = Full coverage of care activity.

s11.title: Practice Economic Model
s11.notes: Show how the practice SaaS is self-financed through commissions on owner subscriptions.
s11.headline: A model self-financed by activations
s11.mechanismDesc: Each pet activated by the owner generates commission paid to the practice. Rule of thumb: ~8 triennial activations / month cover the SaaS monthly equivalent (≈ €69.56 excl. VAT). Steer: €2,253.72 excl. VAT / 3 years (−10%).
summaryItems: Full Web cockpit for the entire clinic
Free VetLight mobile field for all caregivers
Commissions tracked directly on the dashboard
s11.footer: Simple, fast setup in the sales meeting

s13.title: Flash Objection Responses
s13.notes: Direct comebacks to answer the vet or ASV in 10 seconds.
s13.headline: Direct answers in the meeting

objections.label: OBJECTION 1
objections.a: No, it's a global management platform (messaging, records, Care/Horse reminders, agenda, reports). Heart rate reading is one integrated feature among others.

objections.label: OBJECTION 2
objections.a: petsFollow is a broad-spectrum app that manages all of clinical daily life and the client relationship. Only electronic billing is handled separately if needed.

objections.label: OBJECTION 3
objections.q: "Is this extra work for the ASV?"
objections.a: On the contrary, it reduces disorganised phone calls by centralising client requests on a dedicated regulated interface.

objections.label: OBJECTION 4
objections.a: Practice-guided follow-up from ~2,60 €/month (triennial plan 95 €) with all services included and no hidden options.

s13.footer: Confident stance, focused on simplicity and time savings for the care team.
